Class ResourceGeologyDepositCatalog

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.resource.ResourceGeologyDepositCatalog
public final class ResourceGeologyDepositCatalog extends Object
Empirical cartographic hotspot database and physical tensor catalog for geological resources.

Contains real-world geological deposit coordinates (USGS, IAEA, UNESCO, IEA, IHFC) across 10 canonical resource tensors (Coal, Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Uranium, Helium-3, Iron/Copper, Precious Metals, REE/Critical, Mantle Heat Flow, Aquifers).
